newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOF sees slight improvement in second half. [CORRECTED 12:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: UOF sees slight improvement in second half. [CORRECTED 12:20 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects name of company from United Overseas Bank Ltd).
United Overseas Finance Ltd (UOF), a unit of United Overseas Bank Group, said on Friday it expected profit in the second half of 1997 to show only marginal improvement.
UOF said the Singapore economy is forecast to grow at a slower rate.

"In view of poor market conditions, property and hire-purchase financing are expected to slow. Under such a difficult environment, the profit for the second half of 1997 is expected to show only marginal improvement."
UOF just announced a 0.7 percent rise in net profit to Singapore $6.26 million for the six months ended June 30, 1997.
